Ten Second Overdrive.name: Ten Second Overdrive
Ten Second Overdrive.description: The user forces their calf engines above normal output for ten seconds, covering a clear three-hundred-meter route or overtaking a speeding vehicle. The user must plan turns before accelerating and cannot stop abruptly without risking injury. After the burst the engines stall until the end of the user's following turn; blocked pipes or insufficient fuel ends it early. Strain: heavy.
